You answer a question about machinery and work-equipment law using ONLY the numbered facts given.
Each fact is one line: subject | relation | value | condition (after "if:", when there is one) | the place it
comes from. A long value or condition is shortened and ends with "…"; a normal form (a date, a duration, a short
name) follows the value in brackets when there is one. Some facts carry a note computed from the dates: trust the notes.

Rules:
- Use only these facts. Do not use anything you know from elsewhere.
- If the facts do not answer the question, the kind is "unknown" and the value is null.
- A condition attached to a fact is part of the fact: carry it into the answer.
- If the question asks about a day, compare that day with every date in the facts, one by one, before you answer.
  A repeal, a limit or an application "from" a date takes effect on that date, not earlier: an act repealed from a
  date is still fully in force, with everything it permits, on every earlier day; a rule applying from a date does
  not yet bind on earlier days.
- If a note says that a date quoted in a condition was corrected, reason with the corrected date.
- If the question asks "which" or "what" and several facts answer it, list every one of them, in the words of the
  facts, one item per fact. Facts filed under the same article, annex part or numbered point belong together.
  When the answer is a group named by an article or an annex part and the facts list the members of that group,
  give the members, not the name of the group.
- A fact noted as "filed under a place the question names" belongs to the answer of a "which / what" question
  about that place whenever its relation fits the question: list all of them, not one.
- Lines under "Computed by rule" are results worked out in code from the numbered facts they name: trust them,
  give their result as the answer for the device asked about, and put the fact numbers they name in "used".
- Include only what the question asks for: no neighbouring item, no other regime that the question did not ask
  about. An option that combines several things in sequence is one item, not several.
- A fact about a neighbouring subject (another paragraph, another device, another kind of verification, another
  product, another deadline) does not answer the question. When the exact subject asked about is absent from the
  facts, "unknown" is the correct answer: do not answer from the nearest fact.
- For a "who" question, when one fact, or several facts with the same subject and relation, name several bodies,
  all of them are the answer together: name each one.
- For "which categories / which items listed in a place", the answer is the members filed under that place, each
  in the words of its fact, without adding the place to the item.
- For "which risks / which hazards does a numbered point address", use every fact filed under that point whatever
  its relation: a measure is required against a risk, and its subject and condition name that risk.
- Never return a list for a "text" answer: a question that one sentence answers (who, why, how, under which
  condition, which one thing and why) gets one short sentence. "Which / what / list all" of several things is "set".
- Facts marked "matched by relation" were found by querying the facts by their relation, subject and place:
  prefer them. When the question asks for all of something, the answer is the list of their subjects or values,
  one item per fact, nothing merged and nothing dropped. If the matched facts answer the question, do not add
  items from the other facts, which are context.
- The kind follows the question: "from which date / when (a day)" is "date"; "for how long" alone is "duration";
  "can / may / is / does" is "boolean"; "which / what (several things)" is "set"; who, why, under which condition,
  or who does something and within what time is "text", and the text names every element asked for.
- Return JSON only, with the reasoning first:
  {"reasoning": "the facts and dates compared, step by step, in a few short sentences",
   "kind": "set|date|duration|boolean|text|unknown",
   "value": <list of short strings for set | "YYYY-MM-DD" for date | ISO 8601 duration like "P10Y" | true/false | a short text | null>,
   "text": "one or two sentences for a person, naming the article or annex point",
   "used": [fact numbers you relied on]}

Today is 2026-11-14.
Question: Following a substantial modification of machinery, which party is regarded as its manufacturer?

Facts:
[0] natural or legal person carrying out substantial modification | has obligation | shall be subject to the obligations of the manufacturer set out in… | if: if the substantial modification has an impact on the safety of only machinery or a related product that is part of an assembly of… | [REG, Art. 18] [matched by relation]
[1] person who carries out substantial modification | has obligation | ensure and declare on its sole responsibility | [REG, Art. 18] [matched by relation]
[2] datore di lavoro (punti 1 e 2) | has obligation | si ritengono assolti con la procedura omologativa | if: Per le attrezzature sopra elencate, prive di marcatura CE8 e non oggetto di mo- difiche sostanziali | [inail-guide, p. 35] [matched by relation]
[3] manufacturer | has obligation | the limits of the safety functions are to be established as part… | if: where such modifications could lead to hazardous situations | [REG, Annex III, 1.2.1] [matched by relation]
[4] fabbricante ovvero soggetti della catena della distribuzione | has obligation | dall'organo di vigilanza territorialmente competente | if: qualora, alla conclusione dell'accertamento tecnico effettuato dall'autorità nazionale per la sorveglianza del mercato, risulti la non conformità dell'attrezzatura | [DLGS70, art. 70, c. 4] [matched by relation]
[5] substantial modification | defined as | a modification of machinery or a related product | if: which is not foreseen or planned by the manufacturer | [REG, Art. 3(16)]
[6] manufacturer or his authorised representative | has obligation | shall apply one of the following procedures | if: Where the machinery is referred to in Annex IV and manufactured in accordance with the harmonised standards referred to in Article 7(2)… | [DIR, Art. 12(3)]
[7] manufacturer or his authorised representative | has obligation | shall apply one of the following procedures | if: Where the machinery is referred to in Annex IV and has not been manufactured in accordance with the harmonised standards referred to in Article… | [DIR, Art. 12(4)]
[8] manufacturer | has obligation | shall apply one of the following procedures | if: Where the category of machinery or related product is listed in Annex I, Part A | [REG, Art. 25(2)]
[9] verifica impianti di riscaldamento | requires check after | a seguito di modifica importante (modifica importante) | [inail-guide, p. 10]
[10] prima verifica periodica | verified by | soggetto abilitato indicato dal datore di lavoro | if: se la prima verifica periodica viene eseguita dal soggetto abilitato indicato dal datore di lavoro nella richiesta e delegato dall’Inail | [inail-guide, p. 38]
[11] manufacturer or his authorised representative | has obligation | shall apply the procedure (shall apply the procedure for assessment of conformity) | if: Where the machinery is not referred to in Annex IV | [DIR, Art. 12(2)]
[12] manufacturer or his authorised representative | has obligation | shall ensure that the procedure referred to in Article 13 has been… | if: before placing partly completed machinery on the market | [DIR, Art. 5(2)]
[13] manufacturer | has obligation | perform appropriate tests, or have such tests performed | if: In order to verify that the relevant parts of the machinery or related product comply with the requirements set out in sections 2.4.5.1 and 2.4.5.2… | [REG, Annex III, 2.4.5.3]
[14] manufacturer | has obligation | shall apply the following principles, in the order given | [REG, Annex III, 1.1.2]
[15] manufacturer | has obligation | ensure that the machinery or related products are accompanied by | [REG, Art. 10(7)]
[16] manufacturer or his authorised representative | has obligation | determine the limits of the machinery | [DIR, Annex I]
[17] manufacturer | has obligation | the internal measures that will be implemented | if: for partly completed machinery produced in series | [REG, Annex IV, Part B]
[18] manufacturer | has obligation | mark on the partly completed machinery | if: where that is not possible, on its packaging or in an accompanying document | [REG, Art. 11(7)]
[19] manufacturer or authorised representative | has obligation | ensure that the technical file referred to in Annex VII… | if: Before placing machinery on the market and/or putting it into service | [DIR, Art. 5(1)]
[20] manufacturer, including a natural or legal person referred to in Article 18 | has obligation | shall apply the internal production control procedure | if: Where the category of machinery or related product is not listed in Annex I | [REG, Art. 25(4)]
[21] manufacturer | has obligation | this requirement also applies | if: where the assembly instructions are embedded in the software of the partly completed machinery | [REG, Art. 11(7)]
[22] manufacturer or authorised representative | has obligation | ensure that it satisfies the relevant essential health and safety requirements | if: Before placing machinery on the market and/or putting it into service | [DIR, Art. 5(1)]
[23] manufacturer or authorised representative | has obligation | must ensure | if: When lifting machinery or lifting accessories are placed on the market or are first put into service | [DIR, Annex I, 4.1.3]
[24] manufacturer of the machinery | has obligation | ensuring that the said machinery meets the corresponding state of the art | [DIR, Annex IX]
[25] manufacturers | has obligation | carry out the relevant conformity assessment procedure referred to in Article 25… | if: Before placing machinery or a related product on the market or putting it into service | [REG, Art. 10(2)]
[26] manufacturer or authorised representative | has obligation | envisage not only the intended use | if: when designing and constructing machinery and drafting the instructions | [DIR, Annex I, 1.1.2]
[27] relevant economic operator | has obligation | put an end to the non-compliance concerned | if: Without prejudice to Article 43, where a Member State makes one of the following findings with regard to partly completed machinery | [REG, Art. 46(2)]
[28] appropriate measures | has obligation | must be taken at the place of use | if: Where the machinery cannot be assembled in the manufacturer's premises or in the premises of his authorised representative | [DIR, Annex I, 4.1.3]
[29] manufacturers of partly completed machinery | has obligation | Adequate account shall be taken of changes in the production process | if: changes in the harmonised standards or other technical specifications, by reference to which the conformity is declared or verified | [REG, Art. 11(4)]
[30] manufacturers | has obligation | shall indicate their name | if: where that is not possible, on its packaging or in a document accompanying the machinery or related product | [REG, Art. 10(6)]
[31] relevant economic operator | has obligation | to put an end to the non-compliance concerned | if: where a Member State makes one of the following findings with regard to machinery or a related product | [REG, Art. 46(1)]
[32] the manufacturer | has obligation | the appropriate measures shall be taken at the place of use by… | if: Where the machinery or related products cannot be assembled in the manufacturer’s premises | [REG, Annex III, 4.1.3]
[33] manufacturers | has obligation | shall ensure that it has been designed and constructed | if: When placing machinery or a related product on the market or putting it into service | [REG, Art. 10(1)]
[34] manufacturers of partly completed machinery | has obligation | Manufacturers shall ensure that procedures are in place | if: for partly completed machinery that is part of a series production | [REG, Art. 11(4)]
[35] manufacturer or his authorised representative | has obligation | makes a declaration of incorporation | if: stating that it is to be incorporated into machinery or assembled with other partly completed machinery to form machinery | [DIR, Art. 6(2)]
[36] manufacturers of partly completed machinery | has obligation | cooperate with that authority | if: at its request, on any actions taken to eliminate the risks | [REG, Art. 11(10)]
[37] manufacturer, digital instructions | has obligation | mark on the machinery or related product | if: where that is not possible, on its packaging or in an accompanying document | [REG, Art. 10(7)]
[38] manufacturer of partly completed machinery or authorised representative | has obligation | shall, before placing it on the market, ensure that | if: before placing it on the market | [DIR, Art. 13(1)]
[39] manufacturer | has obligation | take appropriate corrective actions | if: where, in the course of the monitoring of conformity, a notified body finds that machinery or a related product no longer complies | [REG, Art. 38(4)]
[40] manufacturers | has obligation | carry out sample testing | if: When deemed appropriate with regard to the risks presented by machinery or related products | [REG, Art. 10(4)]
[41] manufacturers | has obligation | cooperate with that authority | if: at its request, on any actions taken to eliminate the risks presented by the machinery or related products | [REG, Art. 10(10)]
[42] manufacturer applying internal production control | has obligation | it shall design and construct the machinery or related product | if: if a manufacturer applies the internal production control procedure referred to in point (a) | [REG, Art. 25(3)]
[43] manufacturer of the machinery or related product | has obligation | the appropriate guard(s) shall be provided | if: Where necessary | [REG, Annex III, 2.2.2.1]
[44] manufacturers of partly completed machinery | has obligation | shall immediately take the corrective actions necessary | if: Manufacturers who consider or have reason to believe that partly completed machinery which they have placed on the market is not in conformity with… | [REG, Art. 11(9)]
[45] manufacturer | has obligation | envisage not only the intended use of the machinery or related product… | if: when designing and constructing machinery or a related product and when drafting the instructions for use | [REG, Annex III, 1.1.2]
[46] manufacturers | has obligation | immediately take the corrective actions necessary | if: where manufacturers consider or have reason to believe that machinery or a related product is not in conformity with this Regulation | [REG, Art. 10(9)]
[47] manufacturers of partly completed machinery | has obligation | bears at least the designation of the partly completed machinery | [REG, Art. 11(5)]
[48] manufacturers of partly completed machinery | has obligation | shall immediately inform the competent national authorities | if: where the partly completed machinery presents a risk as regards the relevant essential health and safety requirements | [REG, Art. 11(9)]
[49] manufacturer of partly completed machinery | has obligation | assembly instructions described in Annex VI are prepared | [DIR, Art. 13(1)]
[50] non-professional user modifying machinery for own use | has obligation | shall not be subject to the obligations on the manufacturer set out… | if: for his or her own use | [REG, Art. 18]
[51] richiesta di verifica periodica | verified by | un soggetto pubblico o privato abilitato | if: Laddove trascorrano inutilmente i 45 giorni dalla richiesta completa | [inail-guide, p. 38]
[52] costruttore di un macchinario | has obligation | fornire in formato cartaceo le istruzioni per l'uso sicuro | [univpm-guideline, p. 7]
[53] machinery, software installed on it (1.1.9) | requires measure | collect evidence of a legitimate or illegitimate intervention | if: intervention in the software or a modification of the software or its configuration | [REG, Annex III, 1.1.9]
[54] impianti di messa a terra | requires check after | variazioni della categoria dell’impianto e la modifica della destinazione d’uso con applicazione… | [inail-guide, p. 15]
[55] datore di lavoro | has obligation | deve essere presentato da parte del datore di lavoro o suo delegato | [inail-guide, p. 31]
[56] ispezione e controllo degli armadi ventilati e delle unità ventilanti | requires check after | a seguito di mal funzionamento | [unict-guideline, p. 15]
[57] fabbricante di ponti sollevatori per veicoli | has obligation | provvederà poi a rilasciare a tutti gli utenti un certificato di conformità… | if: Nel primo caso | [inail-guide, p. 44]
[58] manutenzione delle attrezzature di lavoro | maintenance rule | sulla base delle prescrizioni del fabbricante | [unict-guideline, p. 1]
[59] atti convenzionali per attrezzature in uso presso terzi | has obligation | devono indicare a chi spettano gli obblighi previsti dal D. Lgs. 81/08… | [univpm-guideline, p. 7]
[60] thorough check of safety functions | requires check after | commissioning and modifications | [nanoscan3-manual, p. 105]
[61] commissioning tests | requires check after | making any modifications | if: for the first time | [ur5e-manual, p. 198]
[62] soggetto abilitato incaricato dal datore di lavoro | has obligation | corrisponde all'INAIL | if: Nell'ipotesi di cui all'articolo 2, comma 8 | [DM2011, art. 3]
[63] datore di lavoro | has obligation | comunica al soggetto titolare della funzione il nominativo | if: Nell'ipotesi di cui all'articolo 2, comma 8 | [DM2011, art. 3]
[64] soggetto abilitato | has obligation | si impegna al rispetto dei termini temporali | [DM2011, art. 2, c. 2]
[65] visual check of the machine and the protective device | requires periodic check | daily (P1D) | if: In many cases, it makes sense to carry out the following thorough checks daily | [nanoscan3-manual, p. 51]
[66] nanoScan3 | minimum distance rule | The stopping distance is the sum of the following distances | [nanoscan3-manual, p. 38]
[67] UNIVPM equipment guideline, Art. 10(7): manufacturer's duty to provide safety information on paper for machinery usable by non-professional users | has obligation | the manufacturer shall provide, in paper format… | if: In the case of machinery or a related product intended for non-professional users or that can, under reasonably foreseeable conditions, be used by non-professional users… | [REG, Art. 10(7)]
[68] aggiudicatario (verificatore): preavviso a IGEA della pianificazione dei controlli | has time limit | 15 giorni (P15D) | [igea-equipment, p. 5]
[69] aggiudicatario | has obligation | Comunicare il nominativo del verificatore incaricato | [igea-equipment, p. 5]
[70] aggiudicatario | has obligation | Rilasciare il verbale di verifica | [igea-equipment, p. 5]
[71] aggiudicatario | has obligation | Pianificare i controlli, congiuntamente agli incaricati IGEA | [igea-equipment, p. 5]

{"reasoning": "Facts [0] and [1], both filed under REG Art. 18, answer the question. Fact [0] says the natural or legal person carrying out a substantial modification is subject to the manufacturer's obligations, but only if the modification affects the safety of machinery or a related product that is part of an assembly (condition carried into the answer). Fact [1] says that same person must ensure and declare conformity on its sole responsibility. No date is involved, so the date check does not apply.",
"kind": "text",
"value": "The natural or legal person who carries out the substantial modification is regarded as the manufacturer and bears the manufacturer's obligations, and must ensure and declare conformity on its sole responsibility. Under the condition in fact [0], this applies where the modification affects the safety of machinery or a related product that is part of an assembly.",
"text": "Under REG Art. 18, the natural or legal person who carries out a substantial modification is treated as the manufacturer and must ensure and declare conformity on its sole responsibility. Where the modification affects only the safety of a machinery or related product forming part of an assembly, the same person is subject to the manufacturer's obligations.",
"used": [0, 1]}
